evidence.proved: first-party sign-up docs state that registration requires a GitHub or BitBucket account and that no credit card is required
evidence.quote: To create your Semaphore account you need a [GitHub](https://github/) or [BitBucket](https://bitbucket.org/) account.

evidence.proved: the GitHub OAuth gate named by Semaphore's sign-up docs carries a verified email address, so email is the identity required at registration and no phone, ID document or card gate is stated
evidence.quote: To get started with GitHub.com, you need to have a personal account and a verified email address.

evidence.proved: first-party sign-up docs state that no payment card is required to register, so the gate is the OAuth account's email rather than a card
evidence.quote: You can test one of the paid plans (no credit card required) or sign up with a free plan forever.
